messages:
Lina M: Quick thought from billing triage: when ingest misses final events we should emit a provisional ledger line so customers see expected cost. Low-risk: mark provisional and reconcile later.

Omar K: How do we match final events to provisionals?

Lina M: Use a provenance_id supplied by edge (X-Provenance) or fallback fingerprint (tenant|route|approx_ts). Store provenance in the provisional row.

Diego R: Need API changes: provisional boolean, provenance_id, estimate_cents, provisional_ttl. Reconcile endpoint should accept action=commit|adjust|void.

Priya S: Console UX: show a "Provisional" badge and allow internal teams a "force commit" button with audit comment. For external invoice exports hide provisionals unless committed.

Omar K: Metrics: billing.provisional_emitted_total, billing.provisional_reconciled_total, billing.provisional_delta_pct_p95. Alert if reconcile_delta_pct > 2% for >30m.

Lina M: Rollout plan: feature flag billing.provisionals.v1, opt-in tenants only. Canary 10 -> 100 -> 500. Docs + FAQ explaining why preview differs.

Diego R: Edge-case: split final events that only partially match estimate. Reconcile must support delta adjustments not just binary void. Ledger PATCH + idempotency required.

console-bot: deploy-bot: billing-service v2.16.0 deployed to staging; flag billing.provisionals.v1=false.

Priya S: I'll draft PRs for schema + console changes and link design doc. Ping @Lina M @Omar K for review.
